content: 144 taosen Izlael ezoqam, Mbumbukiam-qa khakhatap gi-upøgim

Nqanek qame-navøem, yaq enzol ezoqam foa nøzømét. Manqei-qape-qá vavap foa-té giwaniapám neka manqei-qape-qa khamøe foa vø̄geageapam. Tini-geageapám ndǿgo: Manqei-qape-te neka ndaola-te neka leg-te, khamøe bevùma᷄.

Yaq enzol ezoqa nøme vø̄e-omet. Khøuwa fakhanám genøgeavún, Khandi Mbumbukiam-qa khakhatap gone nonqo vø̄ndapavun. Yaq ndego, ndigu enzol ezoqam foa, ndigu Mbumbukiam bazaføgakh gezø-etoam, manqei-qape neka ndaola tingi꞉nam, kandambaqapé møndøzømbe-akhá.
Āv gezømbe-akhá nqǽgo, “Manqei-qape neka ndaola neka leg, naqanøká ndøngì꞉na᷄m. Ni nigi Mbumbukiam-gi sasae ezoqam, tiqa kawa-pap-te, khakhatap bìzizømbøkhæ-awám.”
Yaq no āv qate-ewág nqǽgo: Ezoqa ndigu khakhatap gi-upøgimat, ndigu 144,000 ezoqám. Ndigu Izlael khagua bawabawan-te ate ndægo, āv gindi-uminimát nqǽgo:
Ezoqa bawan-qape, Mbumbukiam-qa qonam nonqo-qa megemege-te go꞉waniapam

Nqanek qame-navøem, yaq nqáe! No ezoqa bawan-qape nøqeív. Ezoqa kandambá tintív. Kopømba mbaín, toqo-gevebam. Ezoqa ngusu vinivinimbá neka bawan vinivinimbá neka manqei vinivinimbá neka manqat vinivinimbá. Ndigu kawa ezoqam-qá qonam nonqo neka Sip Nakhasam-qá megemege-té gono-waniapám. Neka ndigu ndabua loloakh papaqa-papaqa vø̄-uzupam neka epek vø̄-upøgeapam.

Ndigu kandakandá møndæ-akhaemám. Āv gini-akhaemám nqǽgo, “Ezoqam-qa khandi꞉zat matev, nikeza Mbumbukiam-té qando-fakhaté, ndego kawa-qa qonam nonqo-te ndo꞉qomat, neka Sip Nakhasam-té qando-fakhaté.”

Yaq enzol ezoqam ate ndi꞉gu, ndigu kawa-qa qonam nonqo neka megetapak neka søvakha gigiap foa gi-ogitavat, ndigu kawa-qa qonam nonqo-qa megemege-te, ekeza kha, manqei me꞉laém, tiqa bugug até manqei-té, Mbumbukiam vømbō-vizumem.
Yaq ndigu megetapak, ezoqa kopo genøbevap, “Nginik gekha ezoqâm, ndabua papaqa-papaqa loloakh ndi-uzap, neka gekham-tē ginǿ-geavun?”

Yaq qambo-qavøiu, “Khanánqa! No nøtenateáv. Geté qo àboqote-qatéq.” Yaq genø-ein, “Nginik ezoqam ndígu, viniv kandambaqape-te gindu-fakhaz. Ndigu tiqa ndabua, Sip Nakhasam-qá kóuk ginisungúz, yaq ndøgo vøzø̄-papaqa-papaqawam.

Yaq nakémbá, ndigu Mbumbukiam-qá megemege-té gono-waniáp, ndego kawa ezoqam-qa qonam nonqo-te ndo꞉qomat, pavpave nekā lovølova, teqa khoev-te ndimbovizap. Ndego ezoqam, kawa ezoqam-qa qonam nonqo-te ndo꞉qomat, gezømbó-khakhazumát. Andé palai me zømbé-khafúz.
Yaq ndigu ifin nango gezǿvinák neka ibøkha naq ma gezǿpapák neka khøuwa tatas o gekha tatas nøme ndøgo, kha ma gezǿtayák.

Zapa ndǿgo, Sip Nakhasam ndego, livin-mba ndu꞉mia, ma qonam nonqo ndægo, ndego tigí sip keoge ezoqám. Yaq ndego kea kumbutøve-té genǿ-itúb, ta ibøkha-te ndøgo, ezoqa khandi ndøzø-etoam. Yaq Mbumbukiam tiqa bøi-te, bøi einu ate ndægo, gezǿ-vuogím.”
